Subject: Authorities to accord permission to visit abroad on private visit

Sir,

The Central Provident Fund Commissioner has delegated the powers to grant permission
to visit abroad in respect of Group C employees to ACC (HQ)-HR

Accordingly, grant of permission for foreign visit on personal purposes/private visit will
be as under:

CPFC: All Group A and B officers
Additional CPFC (HQ): All Group C officials
